news.title: Vishwajeet Arvind Burungale, Aniruddha Joshi, Girish Govindrao Kakde, Shriganesh Patil acquired 47% stake in Porteus Medical LLP from Invicta Diagnostic Limited (NSEI:INVICTA) for INR 0.05 million.
news.body:
Vishwajeet Arvind Burungale, Aniruddha Joshi, Girish Govindrao Kakde, Shriganesh Patil acquired 47% stake in Porteus Medical LLP from Invicta Diagnostic Limited (NSEI:INVICTA) for INR 0.05 million on January 5, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 0.05 million will be paid by the buyer. As part of consideration, INR 0.05 million is paid towards common equity of Porteus Medical LLP.

As of March 31, 2025, Porteus Medical LLP reported total common equity of INR 0.13 million.

The transaction is subject to approval of merger agreement by Invicta Diagnostic board. The deal has been approved by the board.

news.title: Invicta Diagnostic Limited (NSEI:INVICTA) agreed to acquire 95% stake in Vinchurkar Diagnostics Pvt Ltd for INR 76 million.
news.body:
Invicta Diagnostic Limited (NSEI:INVICTA) agreed to acquire 95% stake in Vinchurkar Diagnostics Pvt Ltd for INR 76 million on January 5, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 76 million will be paid by Invicta Diagnostic Limited. As part of consideration, INR 76 million is paid towards common equity of Vinchurkar Diagnostics Pvt Ltd. Proposed acquisition of upto 95% shareholding of Vinchurkar Diagnostics Private Limited in two Tranches i.e.1st Tranche 51% by June 30, 2026, 2nd Tranche of Maximum 44% within 3 months of first tranche.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Vinchurkar Diagnostics Pvt Ltd reported total revenue of INR 44.54 million.
